item.title: Park Geun-hye Takes the Stage, From Daegu to Chungcheong and Daejeon… “Likely to Go to Busan and Ulsan Too” (등판한 박근혜, 대구 이어 충북·대전까지…“부산·울산도 갈 듯”)
item.description:
Former President Park Geun-hye has begun campaigning in support of People Power Party candidates for the June 3 local elections, focusing on the Yeongnam and Chungcheong regions. (박근혜 전 대통령이 영남·충청권을 중심으로 6·3 지방선거 국민의힘 후보 지원 유세를 시작했다.)

On the 25th, former President Park will visit the birthplace of her mother, Yuk Young-soo, in Okcheon, North Chungcheong Province. This event will be attended by Kim Young-hwan, the People Power Party’s candidate for North Chungcheong Province governor, and Jeon Sang-in, the candidate for Okcheon County head, giving the visit a natural character of supporting these candidates. In the afternoon, former President Park will visit the election camp of Lee Jang-woo, the People Power Party’s candidate for Daejeon mayor, in Seo-gu, Daejeon. The Lee Jang-woo campaign explained the reason for the visit, saying, “Former President Park personally trusts Candidate Lee.” Lee is a member of the ‘pro-Park (pro-Park Geun-hye)’ faction, having opposed the impeachment of former President Park during his time as a National Assembly member in 2016. (박 전 대통령은 25일 충북 옥천에 있는 모친 육영수 여사 생가를 찾는다. 이 자리에는 김영환 국민의힘 충북지사 후보, 전상인 옥천군수 후보 등이 동행하면서 박 전 대통령이 자연스레 이들을 지원하는 성격을 띠게 됐다. 박 전 대통령은 오후에는 대전 서구에 있는 이장우 국민의힘 대전시장 후보 선거 캠프를 찾는다. 이장우 후보 쪽은 “박 전 대통령이 이 후보를 개인적으로 신의한다”고 방문 이유를 설명했다. 이 후보는 2016년 국회의원 시절 박 전 대통령 탄핵 소추에 반대 입장을 밝힌 ‘친박(친박근혜)’계다.)

On the 23rd, former President Park visited Daegu’s Chilseong Market with Choo Kyung-ho, the People Power Party’s candidate for Daegu mayor. This was the first time in nine years since the 2017 impeachment that former President Park appeared at an election campaign site. Park praised Candidate Choo, saying, “Candidate Choo is well aware of the difficult economic situation, so I believe he will come up with good policies.” (박 전 대통령은 지난 23일에는 추경호 국민의힘 대구시장 후보와 대구 칠성시장을 다녀왔다. 박 전 대통령이 선거 유세 현장을 찾은 것은 2017년 탄핵 이후 9년 만이다. 박 전 대통령은 “추 후보가 어려운 경제 상황을 다 잘 알고 계시니 좋은 정책을 마련하실 것으로 생각한다”고 추 후보를 추어올렸다.)

Various opinion polls show Candidate Choo in a fierce battle with Kim Boo-kyum, the Democratic Party of Korea candidate for Daegu mayor. When asked by reporters whether former President Park would also meet with Democratic Party candidate Kim Boo-kyum, she only smiled without a word. (추 후보는 각종 여론조사에서 김부겸 더불어민주당 후보와 치열한 접전을 벌이는 것으로 나타나고 있다. 박 전 대통령은 김부겸 더불어민주당 대구시장 후보도 만날 것이냐는 취재진 물음에는 말없이 미소만 지었다.)

Former President Park is expected to continue campaign support for People Power Party candidates, focusing on the Yeongnam and Chungcheong regions, until the June 3 election day. Yoo Young-ha, a close associate of former President Park and a lawmaker, told *The Hankyoreh* on the 24th, “It seems we’ll go to Busan, Ulsan, and Daegu. A decision on South Chungcheong Province will be made soon.” Kim Tae-heum, the People Power Party candidate for South Chungcheong Province governor, was a leading pro-Park Geun-hye figure during his time as a lawmaker, while Park Hyung-joon, the Busan mayor candidate, was a leading pro-Lee Myung-bak figure. (박 전 대통령은 6·3 선거 당일까지 영남·충청권을 중심으로 국민의힘 후보 지원유세에 나설 것 같다. 박 전 대통령의 측근인 유영하 의원은 24일 한겨레에 “부산, 울산, 대구는 다 갈 것 같다. 충남도 곧 결정할 것”이라고 말했다. 김태흠 충남지사 후보는 과거 의원 시절 대표적인 친박근혜계였고, 박형준 부산시장 후보는 대표적인 친이명박계 의원이었다.)

Evaluations of former President Park’s return to the political stage are mixed. Some within the People Power Party believe that Park’s campaign support will be significantly helpful in competitive regions of the Yeongnam area. On the other hand, some view that the appearance of former President Park, who was impeached, on the front lines could provoke backlash from voters in the Seoul metropolitan area and swing voters. (박 전 대통령의 등판에 대한 평가는 엇갈린다. 국민의힘 일부에서는 박 전 대통령의 지원유세가 영남권 접전 지역에서 적잖은 도움이 될 것이라고 본다. 반면, 일부에서는 탄핵당했던 박 전 대통령이 전면에 등장하는 것이 수도권, 중도층 유권자들의 반발을 불러 올 것이라는 시각도 있다.)

Reporter Cho Hee-yeon choh@hani.co.kr (조희연 기자 choh@hani.co.kr)

item.title: First Inter-Korean Football Exchange in Eight Years Draws Cold Response… "Suggests Need for Realistic Reorganization of North Korea Policy" (8년 만의 남북 축구 교류에도 냉랭…“대북 정책 현실적 재편 시사”)
item.description:
North Korea's Naekohyang Women's Football Club, which won the championship in the final of the Asian Football Confederation (AFC) Women's Champions League (AWCL) held in Suwon, Gyeonggi Province, returned to North Korea on the 24th. This marks the first visit by a North Korean sports delegation to South Korea in eight years, and the first since North Korea defined inter-Korean relations as those between "two hostile states." However, assessments suggest it offers limited potential as a catalyst to ease tensions. Nonetheless, some predict that non-political areas of inter-Korean contact may expand going forward. <<> The 35-member Naekohyang women's football team, including players and staff, departed from Incheon International Airport on a flight to Beijing after completing their eight-day, seven-night schedule. As when they arrived on the 17th, the players passed by members of civic groups bidding farewell with expressionless faces. <<> During the football tournament, North Korea acted in line with its "two states" stance. After defeating Suwon FC Women in the semifinals on the 20th, the Rodong Sinmun newspaper reported solely that the match was held in "South Korea," without any other news about the South. In its coverage of the final that day, the Rodong Sinmun focused on internal solidarity, stating, "The proud athletic achievements (of the players) are instilling the people of the entire country with faith in victory and great inspirational power." At a press conference held after Naekohyang's victory on the 23rd, when a South Korean journalist used the term "North side" during a question, head coach Ri Yu-il expressed displeasure, saying, "Speak the country's name correctly," and then abruptly left the press conference. <<> In a report titled "Assessment and Implications of the North Korean Naekohyang Women's Football Team's Visit to South Korea" released on the 22nd, Kim Bo-mi, Director of the North Korea Research Division at the Institute for National Security Strategy, stated, "The likelihood of the North Korean women's football team's visit leading to a shift in inter-Korean relations is limited," adding, "As North Korea dilutes the concept of ethnicity and approaches inter-Korean relations within the framework of international norms, our North Korea policy must also be realistically reorganized to align with the changed reality." <<> However, there are expectations that the visit of the Naekohyang football team could serve as a starting point for increasing contact in other areas, driven by sports. Yang Moo-jin, a distinguished professor at the University of North Korean Studies, said, "The visit of this delegation would have been difficult without a decision from Chairman Kim Jong-un," and "It shows the potential for expanding inter-Korean contact, even if only in non-political areas." <<> Reporter Jang Ye-ji penj@hani.co.kr (경기도 수원에서 열린 아시아축구연맹(AFC) 여자 챔피언스리그(AWCL) 결승전에서 우승컵을 쥔 북한 내고향여자축구단이 24일 북한으로 돌아갔다. 북한 선수단이 한국을 찾은 건 8년 만으로, 북한이 남북을 ‘적대적 두 국가’로 규정한 뒤 첫 방남이었는데 남북 관계 긴장을 푸는 실마리가 되기에 제한적이라는 평가가 나온다. 다만 앞으로 비정치적 분야를 중심으로 남북 접촉이 확대될 수 있다는 전망도 있다.)

item.title: Innovation Party launches full offensive over Kim Yong-nam’s 'loan shark allegations'... Democratic Party says "keeping a close eye" (혁신당, 김용남 ‘대부업체 의혹’ 총공세…민주당 “예의주시”)
item.description:
On the 24th, the Innovation Party launched a full offensive regarding the allegations that Kim Yong-nam, the Democratic Party candidate for the June 3 by-election in Pyeongtaek, operated a loan shark business under borrowed names, urging him to reconsider his candidacy and calling on the Democratic Party to launch an internal investigation. As the Democratic Party stated it is "keeping a close eye," attention is focused on whether party unification in Pyeongtaek, a late-stage variable, will proceed. (조국혁신당은 24일 6·3 경기 평택을 국회의원 재선거 김용남 더불어민주당 후보의 ‘대부업체 차명 운영 의혹’과 관련해 “김 후보의 거취 숙고, 민주당의 감찰을 촉구한다”며 총공세에 나섰다. 민주당이 “예의주시하고 있다”고 밝히며 선거 막판 변수인 평택을 단일화 여부를 두고 관심이 쏠린다.)

Innovation Party lawmaker Shin Jang-sik held a press conference at the National Assembly on the same day and urged Kim, saying, "Please stop burdening the democratic reform camp and seriously consider your own future." He also called on the Democratic Party to promptly initiate an ethics investigation, noting, "There isn't much time left." Cho Kuk, the Innovation Party candidate for Pyeongtaek, also met with reporters at Jeongto Temple in Anjung-eup, Pyeongtaek, and stated, "The allegations against candidate Kim are seriously hampering the June 3 local elections' critical goal of zero insurrection-related issues." (신장식 혁신당 의원은 이날 국회에서 기자회견을 열고 김 후보를 향해 “더이상 민주개혁진영에 부담을 안기지 말고 스스로 거취를 진지하게 고민해달라”고 말했다. 민주당을 향해서도 “시간이 그리 많지 않다”며 서둘러 윤리감찰에 착수할 것을 요구했다. 조국 평택을 혁신당 후보도 이날 평택시 안중읍 정토사에서 기자들과 만나 “김 후보 의혹이 내란 제로라는 6·3 지방선거의 중대한 목표에 심각한 지장을 주고 있다”고 말했다.)

The allegations that Kim operated a loan shark business under borrowed names erupted on the 22nd when TV Chosun reported on a recording that allegedly showed Kim had run a loan shark business through an agricultural corporation he owned. The recording included Kim’s remarks from 2021 during a conversation with an acquaintance, where he said, "The dividends are all mine anyway," indicating that he was effectively the true owner of the loan shark business. (김 후보의 대부업체 차명 운영 의혹은 지난 22일 티브이(TV)조선이 김 후보가 자신이 소유한 농업회사법인을 통해 대부업체를 운영했다는 의혹이 담긴 녹취록을 보도하며 불거졌다. 녹취록에는 2 021년 김 후보가 지인과 대화하던 중 “배당은 어차피 다 내 것”이라며 사실상 본인이 대부업체 실소유주라는 정황을 보여주는 발언이 담겼다.)

On the same day, Kim issued a statement saying, "In the process of taking over my brother's agricultural corporation, which was facing a management crisis in 2020, a loan shark business was merely included as a subsidiary. I have already filed a closure report with the relevant authorities and am preparing for liquidation proceedings," adding that the allegations were "not true." However, controversy continues as it was revealed that the business renewed its loan shark registration on the 18th. (김 후보는 같은날 입장문을 내고 “2020년 경영위기에 처한 동생의 농업법인을 인수하던 과정에서 (대부업체가) 자회사로 포함됐을 뿐이다. 이미 관계기관에 폐업 신고를 마치고 청산 절차를 준비 중”이라며 해당 의혹이 “사실이 아니다”라고 밝혔다. 그러나 해당 업체가 지난 18일 대부업 등록을 갱신한 것으로 드러나며 논란이 계속되고 있다.)

Kim, meeting with reporters at Jeongto Temple that day, explained, "I first learned about the loan shark business renewal through the report. It appears to have been mechanically extended every three years. I have never been involved in or known about the specific management, nor have I received any dividends or profits." (이날 정토사에서 기자들과 만난 김 후보는 “보도를 통해 대부업 갱신 여부를 처음 알았다. 3년 단위로 기계적 연장됐던 걸로 보인다”며 “구체적인 경영에 대해서는 관여한 바도 없고 알지도 못한다. 배당이나 수익을 받은 바 없다”고 해명했다.)

Democratic Party senior spokesperson Kang Jun-hyeon told reporters that day, "The candidate says it’s different from the facts, doesn’t he?" while adding, "The party’s strategic planning committee or situation room is keeping a close eye." Democratic Party Secretary General Cho Seung-rae said, "We have asked candidate Kim to actively explain himself to the media and report the details to the party." (강준현 민주당 수석대변인은 이날 기자들과 만나 “후보자는 사실관계와 다르다고 말하고 있지 않느냐”면서도 “(당) 전략기획위원회나 상황실에서 예의주시하고 있다”고 말했다. 조승래 민주당 사무총장은 “(김 후보에게) 언론에 적극적으로 소명하고 소명한 내용을 당에 보고하라고 했다”고 말했다.)

Reporter Koh Kyung-joo goh@hani.co.kr (고경주 기자 goh@hani.co.kr)

item.title: ROKS Dosan Ahn Chang-ho, First Korean Submarine to Cross the Pacific… Docks at Canadian Naval Base (도산안창호함, 한국 잠수함 첫 태평양 횡단…캐나다 군기지 입항)
item.description:
ROKS Dosan Ahn Chang-ho (SS-III, 3,000-ton class), a domestically built submarine participating in joint cooperation training between the Republic of Korea Navy and the Royal Canadian Navy, along with the frigate ROKS Daejeon (FFG, 3,100-ton class), docked at the Esquimalt base in Victoria, western Canada, on the 24th (Korean time). (한국과 캐나다 해군 연합협력훈련에 참가하는 해군 국산 잠수함 도산안창호함(SS-Ⅲ·3000톤급)과 호위함 대전함(FFG·3100톤급)이 24일(한국시각) 캐나다 서부 빅토리아 에스퀴몰트 기지에 입항했다.)

ROKS Dosan Ahn Chang-ho set the record as the first submarine in the history of the Republic of Korea Navy to cross the Pacific Ocean. Departing from Jinhae Naval Base on March 25, the submarine safely navigated approximately 14,000 km one way via Guam and Hawaii to Victoria, Canada, breaking the record for the longest voyage ever undertaken by a Republic of Korea Navy submarine. (도산안창호함은 한국 해군 잠수함 역사상 최초로 태평양을 횡단하는 기록을 세웠다. 도산안창호함은 지난 3월25일 진해군항을 출항해 괌과 하와이를 거쳐 캐나다 빅토리아까지 편도 약 1만4000㎞를 안전하게 항해하며 한국 해군 잠수함 역대 최장 항해기록을 경신했다.)

The Navy explained, “It demonstrated its operational capability through oceanic navigation, based on top-class living comfort in its class and outstanding equipment reliability.” Through this Pacific crossing, ROKS Dosan Ahn Chang-ho proved that domestically built submarines can successfully carry out long-term missions even in harsh oceanic environments, which is expected to bolster Korea’s bid for Canada’s submarine project worth up to 60 trillion won. Korea has entered the Canadian submarine procurement competition, offering the Dosan Ahn Chang-ho-class submarine, which is regarded as among the world’s best in the category of conventional submarines of 3,000 tons or more. (해군은 “동급 최고 수준의 거주 편의성과 뛰어난 장비 신뢰성을 바탕으로 한 ‘작전능력’을 대양 항해를 통해 보여줬다”고 설명했다. 도산안창호함은 이번 태평양 횡단을 통해 국산 잠수함이 거친 대양 환경에서도 장기 임무를 성공적으로 수행할 수 있음을 입증해, 최대 60조원 규모 캐나다 잠수함 사업 수주에도 힘이 실릴 전망이다. 한국은 3000톤급 이상 재래식 잠수함 가운데 세계 최고 수준이라고 평가받는 도산안창호급 잠수함을 들고 캐나다 잠수함 수주에 뛰어들었다.)

The Dosan Ahn Chang-ho-class submarine, independently designed and built in Korea, has a maximum underwater speed of over 20 knots (37 km/h) and a crew capacity of about 50 personnel. It measures 83.3 meters in length and 9.6 meters in width. The Republic of Korea Navy submarines are divided into: the Jang Bogo-class (SS-I, 1,200-ton class), the Son Won-il-class (SS-II, 1,800-ton class), the Dosan Ahn Chang-ho-class, and the Jang Yeong-sil-class (3,600-ton class, launched in October last year). (국내에서 독자 설계·제작한 도산안창호급 잠수함은 수중 최대속력은 20노트(시속 37㎞) 이상, 탑승 인원은 50여 명이다. 길이 83.3ｍ, 폭은 9.6m 규모다. 한국 해군 잠수함은 △장보고급(ss-Ⅰ·1200톤급) △손원일급(ss-Ⅱ·1800톤급) △도산안창호급 △장영실급(3600톤급·지난해 10월 진수)으로 나뉜다.)

Since ROKS Dosan Ahn Chang-ho departed from Hawaii, two crew members from the Royal Canadian Navy’s Submarine Command have been on board, participating in navigation and training while communicating with the Canadian Pacific Command through a joint command, control, communications, computers, and intelligence (C4I) system. The Navy assesses this as an example of the deep trust and interoperability between the two navies, serving as an opportunity to directly demonstrate to Canada the excellent operational capability and habitability of the Republic of Korea’s submarines. (도산안창호함이 하와이 출항 때부터 캐나다 해군 잠수함사령부 소속 승조원 2명이 편승해 연합 지휘통제(C4I) 체계를 통해 캐나다 태평양사령부와 교신하며 항해와 훈련에 동참했다. 이는 양국 해군 간의 깊은 신뢰와 상호운용성을 보여주는 사례로, 대한민국 잠수함의 우수한 작전 수행능력과 거주성을 캐나다에 직접 증명하는 계기가 되었다는게 해군의 평가다.)

Major Brittany Bourgeois of the Royal Canadian Navy, who crossed the Pacific aboard ROKS Dosan Ahn Chang-ho alongside Republic of Korea Navy crew members, shared her impressions: “I was very happy and honored to be able to embark on ROKS Dosan Ahn Chang-ho and sail together. It was a rare opportunity to operate with the highly capable Republic of Korea Navy in a unique submarine environment and exchange tactics and perspectives that directly enhance our capabilities. This experience not only broadened our horizons as submarine crew members but also served as a catalyst to further solidify the strong partnership between the two navies.” (도산안창호함에 타고 한국 해군 승조원들과 함께 태평양을 건넌 브리트니 부르주아 캐나다 해군 소령은 “도산안창호함에 편승해 함께 항해할 수 있어서 매우 기쁘고 영광스러웠다”며 “매우 뛰어난 역량을 갖춘 한국 해군과 색다른 잠수함 환경에서 작전을 수행하면서 우리의 능력을 직접적으로 강화할 전술과 관점을 교환할 수 있는 흔치 않은 기회였다. 이와 같은 경험은 잠수함 승조원으로서 우리의 시야를 넓혀주었을 뿐만 아니라 양국 해군 간 강력한 파트너십을 더욱 공고히 하는 계기가 됐다”고 소감을 밝혔다.)

Captain Lee Byung-il, commanding officer of ROKS Dosan Ahn Chang-ho, stated, “The success of the first Pacific crossing by a Republic of Korea submarine is a remarkable achievement that vividly proves the excellent performance and world-class technology of our domestically built submarines in carrying out long-term missions even in harsh oceanic environments. Having worked together with the Canadian crew members and confirmed the solid trust between the two navies, I will perfectly carry out the assigned missions for the remaining period to deeply imprint the unrivaled superiority of the strongest existing diesel submarine.” (이병일 도산안창호함장(대령)은 “대한민국 잠수함 최초의 태평양 횡단 성공은 거친 대양 환경에서도 장기 임무를 수행해 내는 우리 국산 잠수함의 우수한 성능과 세계적인 기술력을 여실히 증명한 쾌거”라며 “캐나다 승조원들과 함께 호흡하며 양국 해군의 굳건한 신뢰를 확인한 만큼 남은 기간에도 현존 최강 디젤 잠수함의 독보적인 우수성을 깊이 각인시킬 수 있도록 주어진 임무를 완벽히 수행하겠다”고 말했다.)

An official port welcoming ceremony hosted by the Royal Canadian Navy will be held on the 25th (local time). Chief of Naval Operations Admiral Kim Kyung-ryul and Defense Acquisition Program Administration Minister Lee Yong-chul are scheduled to attend. The background behind ROKS Dosan Ahn Chang-ho’s demonstration of its Pacific-crossing capability to Canada and the participation of the highest-ranking officials from the Navy and the Defense Acquisition Program Administration in the port welcoming ceremony is the upcoming selection of the contractor for Canada’s submarine project worth up to 60 trillion won next month. The Royal Canadian Navy plans to procure 12 new diesel submarines to replace four aging submarines, with a consortium of Korea’s HD Hyundai Heavy Industries and Hanwha Ocean competing against Germany’s ThyssenKrupp Marine Systems (TKMS). (캐나다 해군이 주관하는 공식 입항 환영 행사는 오는 25일(현지시각) 열린다. 김경률 해군참모총장과 이용철 방위사업청장이 참석할 예정이다. 도산안창호함이 태평양을 횡단하는 능력을 캐나다에 직접 보여주고 해군과 방위사업청 최고 책임자가 입항 환영 행사에 참가하는 배경에는 최대 60조원 규모의 캐나다 잠수함 사업자 선정이 다음 달 예정돼 있기 때문이다. 캐나다 해군은 낡은 잠수함 4척을 대체할 최신형 디젤 잠수함 12척을 도입하려고 하는데, 한국 에이치디(HD) 현대중공업·한화오션 컨소시엄과 독일 기업 티센크루프마린시스템스(TKMS)이 경쟁하고 있다.)

ROKS Dosan Ahn Chang-ho is scheduled to participate in the Rim of the Pacific (RIMPAC) multinational maritime exercise hosted by the U.S. Navy after completing joint cooperation training with the Royal Canadian Navy, and then return. item.title: Jang Dong-hyuk: "On June 3rd, Let's Judge Lee Jae-myung with a Starbucks Coffee in Hand" (장동혁 “6월3일, 스타벅스 커피 들고 이재명 심판하자”)
item.description:
Jang Dong-hyuk, the leader of the People Power Party, said on the 24th, "On June 3rd, let's judge Lee Jae-myung and the Democratic Party while holding our small daily lives, our freedom, and a Starbucks coffee." (장동혁 국민의힘 대표가 24일 “6월3일, 우리의 소소한 일상, 우리의 자유, 스타벅스 커피 들고 이재명과 민주당을 심판하자”고 말했다.)

Leader Jang made this statement at a campaign rally for Incheon Mayor candidate Yoo Jeong-bok held in front of Jakjeon Station in Gyeyang-gu, Incheon, saying, "Let's judge Lee Jae-myung and the Democratic Party with a Starbucks coffee in hand." This came as a critique after President Lee Jae-myung had been continuously criticizing Starbucks for its 'May 18 Tank Day' marketing, and the government had initiated a boycott movement. (장 대표는 이날 인천시 계양구 작전역 앞에서 열린 유정복 인천시장 후보 유세 현장에서 “스타벅스 커피 들고 이재명과 민주당을 심판하자”며 이렇게 말했다. 앞서 이재명 대통령이 ‘5·18 탱크데이’ 마케팅을 벌인 스타벅스를 연일 비판하고 정부가 불매 움직임에 나서자 이를 비판하고 나선 것이다.)

Leader Jang said, "Now, they're even trying to control us having a morning coffee as we open our simple daily lives. If we lose in the local elections, we'll end up in a world where we can't even freely drink coffee." He added, "That's why we must win this local election. I ask everyone who supports the People Power Party, who wants to stop Lee Jae-myung's dictatorship, and who wants to judge the arrogance of the Democratic Party, to join hands and head to the polling stations." (장 대표는 “이제 하다 하다 우리가 소박한 일상을 여는 아침 커피 마시는 것까지 이재명이 통제하겠다고 한다”며 “이제 우리가 지방선거에서 지면 커피도 마음대로 못 마시는 그런 세상이 되고 말 것”이라고 말했다. 이어 “이번 지방선거, 그래서 반드시 이겨야 한다”며 “국민의힘을 지지하는 그리고 이재명의 독재를 막고자 하는 그리고 민주당의 오만함을 심판하고자 하는 모든 분의 손을 잡고 투표장으로 가 달라”고 호소했다.)

Earlier, on the 23rd, Leader Jang had criticized the government's boycott movement against Starbucks on Facebook, stating, "This is collective bullying led by the president. It's another form of state violence. It's the normalization of state violence. Anger and hatred have become tools for strengthening power." (앞서 장 대표는 지난 23일 페이스북에도 정부의 스타벅스 불매 움직임에 대해 “대통령이 주도하는 집단 괴롭힘이다. 또 다른 형태의 국가폭력”이라며 “국가폭력의 일상화다. 분노와 증오가 권력 강화의 도구가 됐다”고 비판한 바 있다.)

Reporter Kim Hae-jung sea@hani.co.kr (김해정 기자 sea@hani.co.kr)

item.title: D-10: ‘Tight Races’ in Seoul, Daegu, Busan, South Chungcheong… Ruling and Opposition Parties See 6 Areas as ‘Competitive’ (D-10, 서울·대구·부산·충남 ‘접전’…여야, 6곳 ‘경합’ 판단)
item.description:
With the June 3 local elections and parliamentary by-elections now ten days away, the races for metropolitan mayors and governors in Seoul, Daegu, Busan, and South Chungcheong are intensifying into photo-finish contests. Marking the first anniversary of the Lee Jae-myung administration, the Democratic Party is pushing to ‘bolster the government’s momentum,’ while the People Power Party is championing ‘checks on one-party dominance,’ rallying their support bases and launching a final push to sway public opinion. (6·3 지방선거 및 국회의원 재보궐선거가 24일 열흘 앞으로 다가온 가운데, 서울·대구·부산·충남 광역단체장 선거가 초접전 양상으로 흐르고 있다. 이재명 정부 1년을 맞아 치러지는 선거에 더불어민주당은 ‘국정 동력 뒷받침’을, 국민의힘은 ‘독주 견제론’을 내세워 지지층을 결집하는 동시에 막판 ‘민심 다잡기’에 돌입했다.)

Summarizing recent poll trends and comments from party officials, both the Democratic Party and the People Power Party view six regions as competitive battlegrounds: Seoul; Busan, Ulsan, and South Gyeongsang (the BU-UL-GYEONG region); Daegu; and South Chungcheong Province, where Democratic candidate Park Soo-hyun faces off against People Power candidate Kim Tae-heum. The Democratic Party also considers North Jeolla Province, where candidate Lee Won-taek competes with independent Kim Kwan-young, a tight race. (이날 최근 여론조사 추이와 각 당 관계자들의 말을 종합하면, 민주당과 국민의힘은 서울과 부·울·경(부산·울산·경남), 대구는 물론 박수현 민주당 후보와 김태흠 국민의힘 후보가 맞붙는 충남지사까지 6곳을 ‘경합’으로 보고 있다. 민주당은 이원택 후보와 무소속 김관영 후보가 경쟁하는 전북까지 접전지로 보는 분위기다.)

According to polls conducted around the start of official campaigning on the 21st, in Seoul, Democratic mayoral candidate Jung Won-oh holds a lead but is being closely pursued by People Power candidate Oh Se-hoon. In a survey by JoongAng Ilbo-Kstat Research (via mobile phone interviews, 17–19th), Jung recorded 45% and Oh 34%, while a CBS-KSOI automated response (ARS) poll (20–21st) showed Jung at 47.4% and Oh at 41.9%. (지난 21일 공식 선거운동 첫날 전후에 이뤄진 여론조사를 보면, 서울의 경우 정원오 민주당 서울시장 후보가 앞서는 가운데, 오세훈 국민의힘 후보가 바짝 뒤쫓는 추세다. 무선전화면접 방식으로 실시된 중앙일보-케이스탯리서치(17~19일) 조사에선 정 후보 45%, 오 후보 34%였고 자동응답(ARS) 방식인 시비에스(CBS)-케이에스오아이(KSOI) 조사(20~21일)에선 정 후보 47.4%, 오 후보 41.9%였다.)

In Busan, a KBS Busan-Korea Research poll (16–20th, mobile phone interviews) gave Democratic candidate Jeon Jae-soo 45% and People Power candidate Park Hyung-joon 34%, while a JoongAng Ilbo-Kstat Research survey (17–19th, mobile phone interviews) showed Jeon at 42% and Park at 35%. (부산의 경우 한국방송(KBS)부산-한국리서치(16~20일·무선전화면접) 조사에서 전재수 민주당 후보 45%, 박형준 국민의힘 후보 34%로 집계됐고, 중앙일보-케이스탯리서치(17~19일·무선전화면접) 조사에선 전 후보 42%, 박 후보 35%로 나타났다.)

A Democratic Party leadership official said, “In Seoul and Busan, the gap between candidates may narrow, but it’s unlikely to reverse the overall dynamics.” A People Power Party leadership official commented, “We will continue to target the weaknesses of opposing candidates until the end, but we cannot let our guard down yet.” (민주당 지도부 관계자는 “서울과 부산의 경우, 후보 간 격차는 줄어들 수 있지만 구도가 바뀔 정도는 아닐 것”이라고 했다. 국민의힘 지도부 관계자는 “막판까지 상대 후보의 취약점을 파고들겠지만, 아직 안심할 상황은 아니다”라고 말했다.)

The Daegu mayoral race, between Democratic candidate Kim Boo-kyum and People Power candidate Choo Kyeong-ho, is also extremely close, within the margin of error at 1–3 percentage points. A KBS Daegu-Korea Research mobile phone interview poll (16–20th) showed Kim at 40% and Choo at 39%. An official from Kim’s camp said, “We believe the trend favoring Kim remains unchanged. We’ll aggressively target undecided voters in the remaining time.” A Choo camp official remarked, “Looking at the on-the-ground atmosphere, I think we’ve already reached a golden cross. A late consolidation of conservative voters is expected.” (김부겸 민주당 후보와 추경호 국민의힘 후보가 겨루는 대구시장 선거는 오차범위 안인 1~3%포인트 사이에서 초접전 양상이다. 한국방송대구가 한국리서치에 의뢰해 16~20일 실시한 무선전화면접 조사에서 김 후보 40%, 추 후보 39%로 나타났다. 김 후보 캠프 관계자는 “김 후보가 우위인 추세에는 변함이 없다고 본다. 남은 시간 부동층을 적극 파고들겠다”고 했다. 추 후보 캠프 관계자는 “현장 분위기만 놓고 보면 이미 골든크로스가 이뤄졌다고 본다”며 “막판 보수층 결집도 나타날 것”이라고 말했다.)

The South Chungcheong gubernatorial election, initially predicted to lean toward the ruling party, has tightened into a competitive race, causing anxiety among Democrats and boosting morale in the People Power Party. Early on, the gap between Democratic candidate Park Soo-hyun and Kim Tae-heum was double digits, but a KBS Daejeon-Korea Research phone interview poll (16–20th) showed Park at 41% and Kim at 37%, within the margin of error. A Democratic lawmaker from the Chungcheong region said, “It seems the incumbent advantage of Governor Kim Tae-heum is being counterbalanced by a sentiment to check the ruling party’s dominance.” (초기 여당 우세로 전망됐던 충남지사 선거가 접전 구도로 재편되자 민주당은 당황한 기류가, 국민의힘은 고무된 분위기가 감지된다. 선거 초반 박수현 민주당 후보와 김태흠 후보의 지지율 격차는 두자릿수였는데, 16∼20일 한국방송대전-한국리서치의 전화면접 조사에서 박 후보는 41%, 김 후보는 37%로 오차범위 내 접전 양상을 보였다. 충청권 한 민주당 의원은 “김태흠 지사에 대한 현역 프리미엄에 여당 독주에 대한 견제 심리가 더해진 것으로 보인다”고 했다.)

The North Jeolla gubernatorial election is also tight. In a KBS-Embrain Public poll (18–20th, mobile phone interviews), Democratic candidate Lee Won-taek recorded 39%, while independent candidate Kim Kwan-young garnered 37%. (전북지사 선거도 접전 양상이다. 18~20일 실시된 한국방송-엠브레인퍼블릭 조사(무선전화면접)를 보면, 이원택 민주당 후보는 39%, 김관영 무소속 후보는 37%를 기록했다.)

Reporter Koh Han-sol sol@hani.co.kr Kim Hae-jung sea@hani.co.kr Ko Kyung-ju goh@hani.co.kr (고한솔 기자 sol@hani.co.kr 김해정 sea@hani.co.kr 고경주 goh@hani.co.kr)

item.title: President Lee Visits ‘That’ Baekun Valley…Citizen “Enjoying It Without Paying Seat Fees” (‘그때 그’ 백운계곡 찾은 이 대통령…시민 “자릿세 안 내고 즐겨”)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung visited Baekun Valley in Pocheon, Gyeonggi Province on the 24th to inspect the use of streams and valleys and the status of safety management. (이재명 대통령이 24일 경기도 포천 백운계곡을 찾아 하천·계곡 이용 실태와 안전관리 상황을 점검했다.)

On Buddha’s Birthday, the President met with citizens visiting the valley and local merchants to hear their on-site opinions. One citizen, who said he came from Jinjeop, Namyangju, told reporters, “The water is great, so I’ve been coming often since I was a child. Since a few years ago, I can enjoy it comfortably without paying a seat fee, so I visit every year,” Senior Presidential Spokesperson Kang Yu-jung said in a written briefing. (이 대통령은 부처님 오신날을 맞아 계곡을 찾은 시민, 이곳 상인들과 만나 현장 목소리를 들었다. 남양주 진접에서 왔다는 한 시민은 “물이 좋아 어릴 때부터 자주 왔는데, 몇 년 전부터는 자리세를 내지 않고 편하게 즐길 수 있어 매년 찾고 있다”고 말했다고 강유정 청와대 수석대변인은 서면 브리핑에서 전했다.)

Baekun Valley in Pocheon is where President Lee carried out strict crackdowns and removed illegal facilities when he was the governor of Gyeonggi Province. The President promoted renovation projects through communication with local merchant associations. Baekun Valley was a place where about 1,600 illegal facilities proliferated, and merchants engaged in rampant illegal business, such as charging visitors seat fees. (포천 백운계곡은 이 대통령이 경기도지사였을 때 강도 높은 단속을 벌여 불법시설 등을 철거한 곳이다. 이 대통령은 지역 상인조합과 소통을 거쳐 정비 사업을 추진했다. 백운계곡은 1600여개의 불법시설이 난립하고, 상인들이 나들이객에게 자릿세를 받는 등 불법 영업이 성행했던 곳이다.)

The President also asked merchants if business was going well and how they operated in the winter. One merchant said, “In winter, the Baekun Valley ‘Dongjanggun’ Festival is held, attracting many citizens.” While inspecting the site, President Lee instructed Minister of Public Administration and Security Yoon Ho-jung to strengthen management, including providing cleaning personnel for the valley area. (이 대통령은 상인들에게 장사는 잘 되는지, 겨울에는 어떻게 운영하는지도 물었다. 한 상인은 “겨울철에는 백운계곡 동장군 축제가 열려 시민들이 많이 찾는다”고 말했다. 이 대통령은 현장을 둘러보다가 윤호중 행정안전부 장관에게 계곡 주변 청소 인력을 지원하는 등 관리 강화를 지시했다.)

The President checked the risk of valley flooding due to heavy summer rains and the management status of hazardous facilities, and also inspected an abandoned sledding site. (이 대통령은 여름철 집중호우로 인한 계곡 범람 위험과 위험시설 관리 상태를 점검하고, 방치된 눈썰매장 현장도 살폈다.)

After finishing his schedule, the President dined at a restaurant run by a valley merchant, eating chicken braised with vegetables and acorn jelly. (이 대통령은 일정을 마친 뒤 계곡 상인이 운영하는 음식점에서 닭볶음탕과 도토리 묵 등을 먹었다.)

Reporter Jang Ye-ji penj@hani.co.kr (장예지 기자 penj@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Starbucks boycott becomes ‘election issue’... People Power Party calls it “state violence” – Democratic Party calls it “Ilbe-style politics” (스벅 불매 ‘선거 쟁점’으로…국힘 “국가 폭력”-민주 “일베식 정치”)
item.description:
As President Lee Jae-myung has repeatedly criticized Starbucks for its “5·18 Tank Day” marketing and the government has joined the boycott movement, the Starbucks incident has emerged as a key issue in the June 3 local elections. (이재명 대통령이 ‘5·18 탱크데이’ 마케팅을 벌인 스타벅스를 연일 비판하고 정부가 불매 움직임에 나선 가운데, 스타벅스 사태가 6·3 지방선거 최대 쟁점으로 떠올랐다.)

In a post on X (formerly Twitter) on the 23rd, President Lee criticized Starbucks Korea for holding a “Siren Mug Event” on the 10th anniversary of the Sewol ferry disaster two years ago, saying, “While the families of the victims were writhing in pain and the people were immersed in sorrow, they must have enjoyed themselves, mocking the victims and ridiculing the people by starting such an event with hidden code of mockery.” The Starbucks logo, the siren, is depicted in Greek and Roman mythology as a mermaid who wrecks ships with her song. The President said, “Linking the incidents, it is hard to see the Tank Day event for this year’s May 18 anniversary as an accidental act that mocked and insulted the Gwangju Democratization Movement and martyr Park Jong-chul.” He fiercely criticized Starbucks’ Tank Day marketing on the day of the May 18 Democratization Movement, saying, “I am furious at the inhuman, bottom-feeding behavior of a low-quality merchant.” <<> Following the President’s criticism, government agencies have also stopped purchasing Starbucks gift certificates or suspended joint projects. The Ministry of National Defense temporarily suspended a project to improve soldiers’ welfare that had been carried out with Starbucks on the 22nd, and the Ministry of the Interior and Safety announced on the 21st that it would stop using Starbucks coffee exchange vouchers, which government agencies had been using for various surveys and contests. <<> The People Power Party has pushed back, calling it “state violence.” <<> People Power Party leader Jang Dong-hyuk said during a campaign rally in Incheon on the 24th, “If we lose the local elections, we will end up in a world where we can’t even drink coffee freely,” adding, “Let’s hold a Starbucks coffee in hand and judge Lee Jae-myung and the Democratic Party.” Seoul mayoral candidate Oh Se-hoon wrote on Facebook on the 24th, “How about we take it down a notch now? Starbucks was clearly wrong, and there’s no room for excuse. The fist wielded by overwhelming power is stronger than a hammer for the people and businesses.” Reform Party leader Lee Jun-seok also criticized, saying, “The style of private retaliation, where he said ‘if you get caught, you’re finished’ during his time as Seongnam mayor, is now in the hands of the nation’s highest authority.” <<> The Democratic Party of Korea criticized the People Power Party and others for using the President’s remarks as a political tool for the election. Secretary General Jo Seung-rae told reporters at the National Assembly, “Aren’t they trying to rally their support base by defending Starbucks’ strange marketing?” Senior Spokesperson Kang Jun-hyun also criticized, “It is the People Power Party that is exploiting the common sense of correcting a wrong historical perspective as a means of political strife and election campaigning.” Spokesperson Park Hae-cheol also commented, “All citizens are outraged at the ‘Ilbe-style political behavior’ that sympathizes with far-right hatred and mockery.” <<> Reporters: Shim Woo-sam wu32@hani.co.kr, Kim Hae-jeong sea@hani.co.kr, Jeong Hye-min jhm@hani.co.kr, Lee Joo-bin yes@hani.co.kr (이 대통령은 지난 23일 엑스(X·옛 트위터)에 올린 글에서 스타벅스코리아가 2년 전 세월호 참사 10주기에 ‘사이렌 머그 이벤트’를 했다며 “유가족들이 고통에 몸부림치고 국민들이 슬픔에 빠져 있을 때, 조롱 코드를 감춘 암호 같은 이런 행사를 시작하며 희생자들을 모욕하고 국민들을 우롱하며 나름 즐겼겠지요”라고 비판했다. 스타벅스 로고인 사이렌은 그리스·로마 신화에서 노래로 배를 난파시키는 인어로 묘사된다. 이 대통령은 “사건을 연결시켜보면 이번 5·18맞이 탱크데이 행사로 광주민주화운동과 박종철 열사를 조롱하고 모욕한 것이 우발적 사건이라 보기 어렵다”고 말했다. 이 대통령은 5·18 민주화운동 당일 스타벅스의 탱크데이 마케팅에 대해 “저질 장사치의 비인간적 막장행태에 분노한다”고 격하게 비판했다.)

item.title: President Lee: "Considering Closure of Sites Like Ilbe"… Government-Wide Response to 'Hate' (이 대통령 “일베 같은 사이트 폐쇄 검토”…정부 차원서 ‘혐오’ 대응 뜻)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung stated on the 24th that he will review legal sanctions, including website closures, for online communities that promote or tolerate hate speech, specifically pointing to Ilbe Storehouse (Ilbe). This comes after President Lee recently criticized Starbucks' "May 18 Tank Marketing" as "inhumane and outrageous behavior," signaling the government's intention to address the culture of hate and mockery spreading across society. (이재명 대통령이 24일 일간베스트저장소(일베)를 지목하며 혐오 표현을 조장하거나 방치하는 인터넷 커뮤니티에 대해 누리집 폐쇄를 포함한 법적 제재를 하는 방안을 검토하겠다고 말했다. 최근 스타벅스 ‘5·18 탱크 마케팅’을 “비인간적 막장 행태”라고 비판한 이 대통령이 사회 전반에 번진 혐오와 조롱 문화에 정부 차원의 대응을 하겠다는 뜻을 표시한 것이다.)

On this day, President Lee shared on X (formerly Twitter) a media report covering claims by Roh Moo-hyun Foundation Director Jo Su-jin, writing: "There are coexisting arguments that mockery and insults like those on Ilbe, which incite social division and conflict, should be protected as free speech, and that sanctions including punishment are necessary. There has been controversy over shutting down Ilbe." He added, "Under strict conditions, we need public debate and actual review of measures such as punishment and punitive damages for mockery and hate speech, and closure, punitive damages, fines, etc., for sites like Ilbe that tolerate or promote mockery and hate. I will also direct this at the Cabinet meeting." Director Jo posted on Facebook on the 23rd, stating, "After the memorial service for former President Roh Moo-hyun, I received a serious report. Young people presumed to be from Ilbe entered the Bongha Village memorial hall, wearing Ilbe T-shirts and making hand gestures symbolizing Ilbe while taking photos." Ilbe is a major far-right online community known for producing and distributing expressions and images that mock or insult the late President Roh. (이 대통령은 이날 엑스(X·옛 트위터)에 조수진 노무현재단 이사의 주장을 다룬 언론 보도를 공유하며 “일베처럼 조롱 모욕으로 사회분열, 갈등을 조장하는 데 대해 표현의 자유로 보호해야 한다는 주장과 처벌을 포함한 제재가 필요하다는 주장이 병존한다. 일베 폐쇄 논란도 있었지요”라고 썼다. 이어 “엄격한 조건하에 조롱, 혐오 표현에 대한 처벌과 징벌배상, 일베처럼 조롱, 혐오를 방치 조장하는 사이트 폐쇄, 징벌배상, 과징금 등 필요한 조치를 허용하는 데 대한 공론화와 실제 검토가 필요해 보인다”며 “국무회의에도 지시하겠다”고 말했다. 조 이사는 지난 23일 페이스북에 “(노무현 전 대통령) 추도식을 마치고 보고받은 심각한 내용”이라며 “일베로 추정되는 청년들이 봉하마을 기념관에 들어와서 곳곳에서 일베 티셔츠를 입은 채로 (일베를) 상징하는 손가락 표시를 하며 사진을 찍었다”라는 글을 올렸다. 일베는 노 전 대통령 서거를 조롱하거나 모욕하는 표현과 이미지 등을 생산·유통하는 대표적인 극우 성향 온라인 커뮤니티다.)

President Lee's remarks on this day appear to stem from the recognition that hate and mockery in online communities have crossed a threshold and can no longer rely solely on internal self-regulation. Additionally, as seen in the controversy over Starbucks' "May 18 Tank Day" marketing—which President Lee condemned as "inhumane and outrageous behavior denying community and democratic values"—hate codes originating from some far-right communities are spilling into real-world spaces like corporate marketing, prompting the government to decide that action is necessary. (이 대통령의 이날 발언은 인터넷 커뮤니티상의 혐오와 조롱이 임계치를 넘어 더는 내부 자정에만 기댈 수 없다는 인식에서 비롯된 것 같다. 아울러 이 대통령은 자신이 “공동체와 민주의 가치를 부정하는 비인간적 막장 행태”라고 성토한 스타벅스의 ‘5·18 탱크데이’ 마케팅 파문에서 보듯 일부 극우 커뮤니티에서 생산된 혐오 코드가 기업 마케팅 등 현실 공간에서 표출되면서 정부 차원의 대처가 필요하다고 판단한 것으로 보인다.)

In response, Democratic Party of Korea spokesperson Lee Ju-hee stated, "We will broadly review legislative alternatives, including fines and closure measures for platforms that prevent or promote hate content under constitutional standards and strict requirements, as well as punishment and punitive damages for mockery and hate speech." However, People Power Party leader Jang Dong-hyuk sarcastically remarked, "Lee Jae-myung says he'll shut down Ilbe. 'Freedom of speech' only for North Korea-praising sites?" (이에 이주희 더불어민주당 원내대변인은 “헌법적 기준과 엄격한 요건 아래 혐오 콘텐츠를 방지·조장하는 플랫폼에 대한 과징금과 폐쇄 조치, 조롱·혐오 표현에 대한 처벌과 징벌배상 도입을 포함한 입법적 대안을 폭넓게 검토해나가겠다”고 말했다. 그러나 장동혁 국민의힘 대표는 “이재명이 일베 폐쇄하겠다고 한다”며 “북한 찬양 사이트들만 누리는 ‘표현의 자유?’”라고 비꼬았다.)

Reporters: Shim Woo-sam, Ko Han-sol, Kim Hae-jung wu32@hani.co.kr (심우삼 고한솔 김해정 기자 wu32@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Democratic-Progressive Ulsan Mayor Candidate Unification Stumbles... Kim Sang-wook Camp Suspends Poll (민주-진보 울산시장 후보 단일화 삐걱…김상욱 캠프 여론조사 중단)
item.description:
The unification of the Democratic Party of Korea and the Progressive Party's candidates for the Ulsan mayoral election in the June 3 local elections is hitting a snag. Both sides said that "the unification has not fallen through," but it remains uncertain whether they can complete the process before early voting begins on the 29th. (더불어민주당과 진보당의 6·3 지방선거 울산시장 후보 단일화가 삐걱이고 있다. 양쪽은 ‘단일화가 결렬된 것은 아니다’라고 했지만 오는 29일 사전투표 시작 전까지 단일화를 마칠 수 있을지 미지수다.)

On the morning of the 24th, the last day of the two-day unification poll, the camp of Kim Sang-wook, the Democratic Party's Ulsan mayoral candidate, released a statement saying, "We are suspending the poll for unification," and added, "Circumstances are being found that suggest organized interference by certain forces." The camp further stated, "We will identify the cause and continue the unification process through subsequent consultations with the Progressive Party." It is known that Kim's camp believes members of the Shincheonji sect or supporters of the People Power Party are interfering in the poll to make reverse choices. <<> The camp of Kim Jong-hoon, the Progressive Party's Ulsan mayoral candidate, opposed this. Kim Jong-hoon's camp said, "Kim Sang-wook's unilateral declaration to suspend the poll is incomprehensible," and urged for the poll to resume, stating, "The only way (to prevent disruption) is for Kim to proceed with the poll normally." The two candidates had originally planned to announce the unified candidate based on the poll results on the night of the 24th. <<> Cho Seung-rae, the Democratic Party's general election campaign headquarters chief, said, "The unification is still valid, but the survey has been suspended." Jeong Hye-gyu, the Progressive Party's spokesperson, said, "Even now, carry out the primary as agreed." <<> Reporter Jeong Hye-min jhm@hani.co.kr (김상욱 민주당 울산시장 후보 캠프는 이틀간의 단일화 여론조사 마지막날인 24일 오전 입장문을 내고 “단일화를 위한 여론조사를 중단한다”며 “일부 세력의 조직적 개입이 의심되는 정황이 발견되고 있다”고 했다. 캠프는 이어 “원인을 파악하고 진보당 쪽과 후속 협의를 통해 단일화를 계속 진행하겠다”고 덧붙였다. 김 후보 쪽은 신천지 신도나 국민의힘 지지층이 여론조사에 개입해 역선택을 하고 있다고 보는 것으로 알려졌다.)

item.title: Han In-ok, Wife of Former Grand National Party Leader Lee Hoi-chang, Passes Away at 88 (‘이회창 전 총재 부인’ 한인옥 여사 별세…향년 88)
item.description:
Han In-ok, the wife of Lee Hoi-chang, former leader of the Grand National Party (predecessor of the People Power Party), passed away on the 24th. She was 88. (이회창 전 한나라당(국민의힘 전신) 총재의 부인 한인옥 여사가 24일 별세했다. 향년 88.)

Born in Haman, South Gyeongsang Province, in 1938, the deceased graduated from Gyeonggi Girls’ High School and the Department of Home Economics Education at Seoul National University’s College of Education. Her father was former Supreme Court Justice Han Seong-su. (1938년 경남 함안에서 태어난 고인은 경기여고와 서울대 사범대 가정교육과를 졸업했다. 고인의 아버지는 한성수 전 대법관이다.)

The deceased married former leader Lee in 1962. She is recognized for her steadfast support, offering advice and silently assisting her husband during his campaigns as the Grand National Party’s presidential candidate in 1997 and 2002, both of which ended in defeat. Notably, during former leader Lee’s 2002 presidential bid, she reportedly said, “Even if the sky splits in two, we must win the presidential election,” a remark that drew public attention. (고인은 1962년 이 전 총재와 결혼했다. 1997년과 2002년 이 전 총재가 한나라당 대통령 선거 후보로 출마했다가 낙선했던 시기를 포함해 남편 곁에서 조언을 건네며 묵묵히 내조했다는 평가를 받는다. 특히 2002년 이 전 총재가 대선 후보로 출마했을 때 “하늘이 두 쪽 나도 대선에서 이겨야 한다”고 말한 사실이 알려져 주목받기도 했다.)

Former lawmaker Yoo Seung-min, who regarded former leader Lee as his “political mentor,” paid tribute on Facebook that day, saying, “She was someone who always maintained her elegant dignity” and “a warm person who gave me courage whenever I faced trials.” She is survived by former Prime Minister Lee, two sons, and one daughter. (이 전 총재를 ‘정치적 스승’이라 해 온 유승민 전 의원은 이날 페이스북에 “항상 단아한 기품을 잃지 않으셨던 분”이라며 “제가 시련을 겪을 때마다 용기를 주시던 따뜻한 분”이라고 추모했다. 유족으로는 이 전 총리와 아들 2명, 딸 1명이 있다.)

The funeral hall is set up in Special Room No. 2 at the funeral center of Sinchon Severance Hospital in Seodaemun-gu, Seoul. The burial ceremony will take place on the 26th at 8:20 a.m., with the burial site at Gwangneung Memorial Park. (빈소는 서울 서대문구 신촌세브란스병원 장례식장 특2호실에 마련됐다. 발인은 오는 26일 오전 8시20분, 장지는 광릉추모공원이다.)

Reporter Jang Ye-ji penj@hani.co.kr (장예지 기자 penj@hani.co.kr)

item.title: "Defending Starbucks Doesn't Help the People Power Party at All"... Political Analysts Point to a 'Misstep' (“스벅 옹호 국힘에 전혀 도움 안돼”…정치 평론가들 ‘악수’ 지적)
item.description:
Amid the Starbucks Korea '5·18 Tank Day' marketing controversy emerging as a major issue in the June 3 local elections, political analysts criticized the People Power Party (PPP), including its leader Jang Dong-hyuk, for defending Starbucks, stating it does not benefit the election. (스타벅스코리아의 ‘5·18 탱크데이’ 마케팅 문제가 6·3 지방선거 최대 쟁점으로 떠오른 가운데 정치평론가들은 장동혁 대표를 포함한 국민의힘이 스타벅스를 옹호하는 것은 선거에 도움이 되지 않는다고 비판했다.)

Choi Chang-ryul, a professor at Yongin University, told The Hankyoreh on the 24th, "The PPP's defense of Starbucks will cause centrist conservatives to defect," adding, "People who have a favorable view of the Democratic Party but were reluctant to vote for them might now head to the polls." He said, "Starbucks' Tank Day marketing is unacceptable. The PPP should have said Starbucks must not do this. If they had, it could have been a good opportunity to expand support to the center." Choi added, "This reveals the anachronistic and regressive mindset prevalent within the PPP's base, so it won't help the election at all." <<> Shin Yul, a professor of political science and diplomacy at Myongji University, also told The Hankyoreh, "May 18 is not a matter of conservative versus progressive. It is the most tragic event in modern Korean history, where countless innocent civilians were slaughtered for power." He stated, "(The PPP defending Starbucks) is absolutely not good for conservatives." He added, "Since it's a fact that Starbucks engaged in behavior that could cause misunderstanding, they (the PPP) must first accept that." <<> Political analyst Park Sang-byung assessed that it could have some impact in the Yeongnam region, rather than in Seoul or the metropolitan area elections. He predicted, "Looking at voter behavior in places like Seoul, people won't change their votes just because of Starbucks," but added, "It has become a basis for conservatives to rally, so regions like Daegu and North Gyeongsang may unite tightly. Conversely, in Gwangju, the Democratic Party's support base will solidify." <<> Park Sung-min, CEO of political consulting firm Min, said, "Both the president and the PPP are going overboard," noting, "The company already apologized and made its CEO step down, yet having state agencies step in to sever ties and investigate is excessive. On the other hand, the PPP's call to 'post Starbucks coffee certification shots' is also excessive." <<> Reporter Jung Hye-min jhm@hani.co.kr Reporter Jo Hee-yeon choh@hani.co.kr ( 최창렬 용인대 교수는 24일 한겨레에 “국힘의 스타벅스 (옹호) 발언이 중도 보수층의 이탈을 가져올 것”이라며 “더불어민주당에 호감은 갖고 있지만 거기에 투표까지는 안 하려던 사람들이 투표장으로 갈 수 있다”고 말했다. 그는 “스타벅스의 탱크데이 마케팅은 있을 수 없는 것이다. 국힘은 스타벅스가 이렇게 하면 안 된다고 해야 했다. 그렇게 했다면 지지를 중도로 확장할 수 있는 좋은 계기가 될 수 있었다”고 말했다. 최 교수는 “국민의힘 저변에 흐르는 시대착오적이고 퇴행적인 인식을 그대로 보여준 거라 선거에 전혀 도움이 안 될 것”이라고 덧붙였다. )
